Updates the physical address information for the currently authenticated organization in Grafana. This PUT endpoint modifies the organization's address details, which may include street address, city, state, postal code, and country information. The operation requires appropriate authentication and permissions to modify organization settings, and it affects only the organization context of the current user session.
